capabilities: Rewrite pasted clipboard text with regex replacement rules
Run JavaScript script rules, including async code with fetch
Use selected editor text via the $SEL placeholder or a with-selection replacer
Apply rules sequentially and toggle the transform globally or via commands
Test rules in a Try source/Try destination sandbox
extras: Ships with default example rules for GitHub and Wikipedia; versioning is 0.X.Y, so major-version-zero updates may contain incompatible changes.
motivation: The author uses it to expand short issue links into links to an internal issue tracker (e.g. ASD-123 becomes an internal link).
problem: Obsidian pastes clipboard text as-is, so turning pasted links or issue IDs into formatted links requires manual editing each time.
summary: Paste interceptor that rewrites clipboard text with user-defined regex replacement rules or JavaScript script rules before it lands in the note.
